description: What GET /api/v1/sync/rules adds for `vericto-proxy mcp` (docs/design/mcp-proxy-mode.md §9.11, §11.2, Q8). The proxy sends the request header on every sync and names its database (database_id). The section is absent for any other proxy, whose body and ETag do not change. `identities` is only in a signed body (a proxy that announces policy_language cel/1): each runtime key of the workspace with sql:read, not revoked or expired, with the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the full key. tiers.read is enabled when the proxy's own key holds sql:read; write, delete and ddl stay off and mcp_write_tiers_allowed false until Gate W.
